text:
Mira Patel: Quick update — Aurora Retail signed off on a joint pilot. They want a Marketplace listing + Dedicated capacity for peak shopping hours. Big win for partnerships team :tada:
Devon Lee: amazing news!! who on AE will handle the renewal/contract? cc @Mira
Mira Patel: @Devon i'll hand off after kickoff. AE owner will be Samir for the pilot phase.
Samir Khan: I'll run the pilot. Plan: 2-week baseline, then enable dedicated GPU pool + prefix caching. Goal: 20% token-cost reduction and <120ms P95 for short checkout flows.
Jen Ortega: Marketing: we can do a joint launch blog + 1-page case study if we hit the latency target. Also want a quote from product.
Cecil Tan: Eng note — we'll provide a reference arch for their infra team. They'll use Redwood Private in their VPC for PCI data, and Hosted for non-PII features. Need a small network diagram and KMS integration steps.
Mira Patel: timeline: kickoff Wed 9am PT. Samir to send SOW by EOD tomorrow. Ops: request for Dedicated pool capacity (2x A10s) for pilot weeks 1-4.
Samir Khan: SOW draft pushed to <https://redwood.workspace/drive/aurora-pilot-sow|drive link> (comments welcome).
deploy-bot: Scheduled: Dedicated pool reservation requested (2 GPUs) — ticket #INC-4629 created. ETA for approval: 24h.
Devon Lee: Nice. Can we add a co-marketing clause for a customer quote if pilot goes well?
Mira Patel: Yep — 30/60/90 review checkpoints. If we hit metrics at 30d: marketing assets and marketplace highlight.
Jen Ortega: I'll prep a press outline and one pager. Samir, can you capture the first benchmark numbers in this thread once you run the baseline?
Samir Khan: Will do. Quick note for eng: sample deploy config we'll use:
```
model: retail-compact-v2
batching: auto
cache: prefix
qps: 50
```
Cecil Tan: Got it. I'll add a secure KMS snippet and a network diagram to the reference arch doc.
Mira Patel: Huge thanks team — big customer signal for both Marketplace + Private product motion. Keeping execs updated after kickoff. :rocket:
